jurisdiction_name: Marietta Board of Lights and Water (Marietta Power)
summary: City-owned utility board will not accept or consider applications or proposals for new large-load (10 MW+) customers while staff and the city draft an ordinance; effective immediately.
notes: Separate from the city council land-use moratorium already upstream (ga-marietta-2026, also through 2026-12-31). Citizenportal (AI summary of meeting video) posted 2026-09-03; exact BLW meeting date not confirmed (late Aug/early Sep 2026). Board debated whether it covers the full service territory or only city limits; staff to present draft ordinance by 2026-12-01.

jurisdiction_name: Lewis County PUD (PUD No. 1 of Lewis County)
summary: Commission halted new and pending electric service applications for computing or data processing loads tied to cryptocurrency mining; lifted after the New and Increased Large Load Policy was updated.
notes: Motion by Commissioner Kostick carried unanimously 2018-04-03 (six likely applicants sought 13-33 MW). Public hearing 2018-05-15. Removed by unanimous vote 2020-09-15; loads now handled case by case under the large load policy.

summary: Co-op board of trustees imposed a six-month moratorium on new cryptocurrency mining loads while staff reviewed line-extension and rate policy; requests already in progress were grandfathered.
notes: Expiry is the scheduled six-month date; whether the optional extension was used was not found. FEC later adopted High Density Load policy E&O 337 (current version effective 2024-11-25) covering crypto, data centers and grow operations. Service counties from co-op territory (Flathead, Lincoln), approximate.
